app.stopDaemonHint: Stops the whole daemon: all audio stops and the virtual devices go away
app.changedElsewhere: The graph was changed elsewhere. Apply to overwrite it, or Revert to load it.
app.noProvider: This system has no virtual audio devices yet: a “Virtual microphone” or “Virtual speakers” block stays silent{error}. Send to a playback device instead, or install the USB/IP client.
app.emptyHint: Add an Input and an Output from the bar above, link them, then press Apply.
category.trigger.hint: Fires an action when something happens
kind.virtual_mic.hint: A microphone other programs can pick
kind.virtual_speaker.hint: An output other programs can play into; you get what they play
kind.mixer.hint: Adds [sound in 1](port:in) and [sound in 2](port:in2) together and sends the result to [sound out](port:out). Add inputs with +, or link several sounds to the same input.
kind.gate.hint: Lets the [sound](port:in) through only while [open when](port:open) is true.
kind.level.hint: True while the sound is loud enough
kind.hotkey.hint: An action each time the keys are pressed
field.program.help: The program whose sound is taken: its name (for example `firefox.exe`) or its process number. It has to be playing sound for the block to hear it.
field.recordingDevice.help: The recording device to listen to (a microphone, a line input). Leave it on the system default to follow the one Windows uses.
field.playbackDevice.help: The playback device that receives the sound (speakers, headphones, a cable). Leave it on the system default to follow the one Windows uses.
field.micName.help: The name of the virtual microphone, as other programs list it. Free text.
field.speakerName.help: The name of the virtual speaker, as other programs list it. Free text.
field.gain.help: How much the sound is made louder (above 0 dB) or quieter (below 0 dB).
field.startsOn.help: Whether the condition is true when the engine starts.
field.threshold.help: The level above which the sound counts as loud enough.
field.operation.help: How the two conditions are combined (and, or, exclusive or...).
field.shortcut.help: The keys that trigger the action, even when another program has the focus.
field.interval.help: The time between two actions, in milliseconds.
field.delay.help: How long the sound is delayed, in milliseconds. Useful to line it up with another source.
field.hold.help: How long the condition stays true after its input stops being true, in milliseconds.
field.after.help: How long the input has to be true before the condition becomes true, in milliseconds.
field.soundboard.help: The soundboard whose pads this block plays. Pads are set up in the Soundboards page.
field.listenPort.help: The UDP port to listen on (1 to 65535). Anyone on your network who knows it can send sound here: name the stream or the computer you accept.
field.streamName.help: The name of the stream (VBAN). Empty accepts any stream when receiving.
field.fromComputer.help: Accept sound only from this computer. Empty accepts any computer.
field.sendTo.help: The computer or program that receives the sound: its name or its address. The network is not encrypted: use it on a network you trust.
field.sendPort.help: The UDP port of the receiver (1 to 65535).
field.maxReduction.help: The most the noise is lowered by, in dB. A lower limit keeps more of the room and sounds more natural.
help.title: Documentation
help.col.name: Name
help.type.audio: A stream of sound. Only a sound output can be linked to a sound input.
help.type.condition: A yes/no that follows something and changes over time. Conditions open or close sound, and are combined by the logic blocks.
help.type.action: An event: something that happens at one moment (keys pressed, a timer tick, a condition changing). Actions change variables or play pads.
kind.network_in.warning: Anyone on your network who knows the port can send sound here: name the stream, or the one computer, you accept.
kind.network_out.warning: The network is not encrypted: use it on a network you trust.
kind.deep_filter.warning: It needs the DeepFilterNet module, uses some processor time and adds about 40 ms of delay. Without the module the sound goes through unchanged.
palette.title: Search
palette.placeholder: Type a command, a setting or a block…
kind.text.hint: A piece of text that other blocks can use.
kind.integer.hint: A whole number that other blocks can use, for example to set a wait.
kind.number.hint: A number with a decimal part that other blocks can use, for example to set a gain.
kind.join.hint: Makes a text from a template: `$1` stands for [value 1](port:arg1), `$2` for [value 2](port:arg2), and so on. A value can be text, a number or a yes/no. The result goes out of [text out](port:out).
kind.math.hint: Combines two numbers: [a](port:a) and [b](port:b). The result goes out of [result](port:out). A division by zero gives 0.
help.type.text: A piece of text. A number or a yes/no can be linked where a text is wanted: it is written out.
help.type.int: A whole number. It can be linked where a decimal number is wanted.
help.type.float: A number with a decimal part.
field.integer.help: The whole number this block sends.
field.number.help: The number this block sends; use a dot for the decimal part.
field.template.help: The text to make. `$1`, `$2`… (or `${1}`) are replaced by the values linked to the block, in order; `$$` is a dollar sign.
kind.compare.hint: Yes while [a](port:a) is greater than, less than or equal to [b](port:b), as chosen. A number that is not linked counts as 0.
kind.text_compare.hint: Yes while the text [a](port:a) is the same as, contains, starts with or ends with the text [b](port:b). Capital letters count.
kind.choose.hint: Sends [then](port:then) while [when](port:when) is yes, and [else](port:else) when it is not.
kind.counter.hint: A whole number that actions change: [up](port:up) adds one, [down](port:down) takes one off, [reset](port:reset) goes back to the first number.
kind.volume.hint: How loud the sound at [in](port:in) is, in decibels: 0 is the loudest, -120 is silence.
field.counterStart.help: The number the counter starts at, and goes back to on reset.
node.nameHint: Name of this block (free text: write what you like)
node.summed: Several links on this input: they are added together
kind.branch.hint: Sends the [sound in](port:in) out of the output of the first condition that is true ([if](port:when1) → [then 1](port:out1)), otherwise out of [else](port:else). The + adds an “else if”.
kind.select.hint: Takes the sound of the first condition that is true ([sound 1](port:in1) when [if](port:when1)), or the [else](port:else) sound, and sends it to [sound out](port:out). The + adds an “else if”.
kind.delay.hint: Delays the sound, for example to line it up with another source
kind.all.hint: True while every linked condition is true: add inputs with +, or link several conditions to one input
kind.any.hint: True while at least one linked condition is true: add inputs with +, or link several conditions to one input
kind.hold.hint: Stays true for a while after the [condition](port:in) stops
kind.after.hint: Becomes true once the [condition](port:in) has been true for a while, and false as soon as it is
kind.change.hint: Sends an action when the [condition](port:in) becomes true ([becomes true](port:rise)), and another when it becomes false ([becomes false](port:fall))
app.cleanDevicesHint: Windows keeps a record of every old name of a virtual microphone or speaker. No old device to remove.
app.cleanCancelled: Cleaning cancelled: administrator rights were refused, nothing was removed
kind.noise_reduction.hint: Takes the background noise out of a voice (fan, keyboard, hiss). For a stronger reduction, see [DeepFilterNet](kind:deep_filter).
kind.soundboard.hint: The sound of the pads you play, as many at once as you like. Pads are set up in the Soundboards panel.
field.soundboardMissing: This soundboard does not exist any more: the block stays silent and Apply is refused.
soundboards.title: Soundboards
soundboards.notInGraph: No block plays this soundboard yet: add one, link it, then Apply.
soundboards.notAppliedYet: Its block is on the editor but not applied yet: press Apply for the pads to play.
soundboards.pathPlaceholder: Path of a sound file on this computer
soundboards.dropHint: Drop sound or video files here (WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, AAC, MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM). A video keeps only its sound. Each file becomes a pad; it is copied and converted once.
soundboards.dropHintDesktop: Choose files with the button, drop them on this window, or type a path (WAV, MP3, FLAC, OGG, AAC, MP4, MOV, MKV, WebM). A video keeps only its sound. Each file becomes a pad; it is copied and converted once.
soundboards.noPads: No pad yet. Add sounds, or make an empty pad.
soundboards.cannotPlay: The pads play only when a block of this soundboard is in the running graph
soundboards.loopHint: Plays again and again until stopped (not for long sounds read from the disk)
soundboards.memoryIdle: Not in use: nothing is reserved while no soundboard is in the running graph.
soundboards.streams: {count} long sound(s) read from the disk
soundboards.late: The disk was too slow for a long sound: it had gaps. Try a faster disk, or fewer long sounds at once.
soundboards.cacheLimit: Most memory the soundboards may use (MB)
soundboards.cacheInvalid: The memory limit is a whole number of megabytes, {min} at least.
soundboards.cacheHint: The change applies the next time a soundboard starts playing.
soundboards.keyIdle: Works while this soundboard is in the running graph
soundboards.exclusiveHint: Playing this pad first stops every other sound of this soundboard
soundboards.fadeHint: How long this pad takes to fade out when it is stopped
soundboards.partHint: Plays only a part of the sound. In a long sound read from the disk, a start far from the beginning may begin a moment late.
soundboards.compressNow: Store this sound compressed, without loss: it plays exactly the same and takes less room on the disk
soundboards.compressInvalid: The size above which sounds are compressed is a whole number of megabytes, or 0 for never.
soundboards.compressHint: A sound whose plain samples take more than this is stored compressed when imported (lossless: it plays exactly the same).
modules.title: Modules
modules.intro: Optional components that are not part of the program. Nothing is downloaded unless you ask for it here.
modules.fromSystem: Using the copy this computer already has
modules.downloadNote: Not on this computer. Switching it on downloads about {mb} MB from the official source, once, into the modules folder.
modules.noDownload: Not on this computer, and it cannot be downloaded on this system: install it with the system’s package manager.
modules.needed: {name} is needed to read this file. Install the module?
soundboards.hold: Only while the key is held
soundboards.holdHint: The pad plays while you hold the shortcut and stops when you let go
soundboards.addTriggerHint: Adds an action input that plays a pad each time an action arrives (a keyboard shortcut, a timer, a condition changing...)
settings.title: Settings
settings.tray: Show the icon in the notification area
settings.trayHint: A click on the icon opens the interface; its menu can also stop the engine or quit.
settings.logonHint: Starts automatically when you open your session.
kind.network_in.hint: Sound sent over the network (VBAN, like Voicemeeter).
kind.network_out.hint: Sends the sound to another computer or program over the network (VBAN, like Voicemeeter).
kind.deep_filter.hint: A larger noise reduction than the one built in ([noise reduction](kind:noise_reduction)): it keeps the voice and takes out most other sounds.
modules.notSupported: This build of the program does not include the code that runs this module.
app.startEngineHint: Starts again the graph that was last applied
